thread:
alex: Heads-up — vuln triage last night pulled a much larger SIEM export than intended. Need a plan to tighten retention for triage exports and clarify who can request raw snapshots.
maria: Saw the alert. Which exporter was used? snapshot or stream?
alex: forensic-snapshot-service. Runbook default was accidentally set to 24h instead of 2h.
sam: Can we force snapshot exports behind a JIT approval that issues a short-lived token? Analysts shouldn't be able to request long windows by default.
jen: Agree. Also KMS unwrap should be restricted — only oncall or a delegated analyst role can unwrap the CMK for snapshots.
security-bot: Alert: export id export-20260322-91 included PII flagged by DLP. Created ticket ENGSEC-432.
oncall: @alex @maria I've rotated the pre-signed URL at 09:12 UTC and revoked access.
alex: Proposed next steps: 1) change runbook default snapshot window to 2h; 2) enforce RBAC in exporter service; 3) require ephemeral KMS unwrap with approval; 4) run post-export scrubbing job. Thoughts?
maria: For RBAC enforcement, can we require a scope claim like export:forensics:ttl=2h and evaluate via OPA?
sam: OPA works. Quick snippet: package exporter.auth 
allow { input.requester in data.roles["forensics_analyst"] 
 input.params.ttl <= 7200 }
jen: Also add a human approval for >30m exports. <=30m can be auto-approved by a service account; larger requests must include a ticket id.
alex: Threshold of 30 minutes sounds reasonable. For KMS, log unwrap events must include requestor, ticket id, and ephemeral token id. Can we bake that into the key policy or envelope layer?
maria: We can add an IAM condition that requires audit:ticket_id in the request context, otherwise deny. Will need compliance signoff and a key-policy update PR.
jen: I'll draft the KMS change PR and include language for the audit fields. Who picks up the oncall gating/rotation flow?
oncall: I'll take point. Opening TICKET-ENG-754 and adding a runbook step to revoke pre-signed URLs after 10 minutes.
sam: Also tighten streaming exports: currently 24h allowed — change triage streams to 1h max and ensure DLP scrub applied before allowing PII fields.
alex: Actions: jen PR for key policy, maria PR for OPA policy, oncall ticket for URL rotation and revocation, sam update exporter configs, alex to coordinate compliance review and record decisions. Scheduling a 20-minute sync at 10:30 UTC.
maria: One more thing: add a DLP risk-gate that auto-pauses any export where DLP score > 0.6 and requires manual review.
jen: DLP hook is doable — I'll add a pre-export webhook to webhook://dlp-check the exporter calls before snapshot generation.
oncall: Confirmed last night's bad export is revoked and short TTL applied.
security-bot: Note: ENGSEC-432 updated with export metadata and remediation steps.
alex: Thanks all — I'll capture these notes into ENGSEC-432 and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
